senses.gloss:
इड् f. (also written इल् in Veda).
[इल्-क्विप्, वा लस्य डः]
1 An offering
or oblation, libation offered to the
gods.
--2 Prayer, flow of speech.
--3 The earth.
--4 Food.
--5 The
rainy season.
--6 The third of the
five prayāgas (इडो यजति).
--7 People
or subjects.
--8 (--pl.) The object of
devotion.
--Comp.
--देवता a deity
of libation.

ईड् {c2c} A. (ईट्टे, ईडांचक्रे, ऐडिष्ट, ईडितुं,
ईडित)
1 To praise; अग्निमीडे पुरोहितं
Rv. 1. 1. 1; शालीनतामव्रजदीड्यमानः
R. 18. 17; नेडिषे यदि काकुत्स्थं
Bk. 9. 57, 18. 15.
--2 To implore,
request, ask for (with two acc.);
उपस्थाय मातरमन्नमैट्ट Rv. 3. 48. 3.
--Caus.
1 To ask.
--2 To praise.
